note: Philippines, read on the Bureau of Immigration's own pages on 2026-10-30 (its fee tables marked as updated 6 March 2014). A performer engaged for a run takes the Special Work Permit for artists and athletes (the work engine's route), which doesn't make a residence. To live there on work, the Pre-arranged Employment Visa (9G) is for foreign nationals coming to engage in any lawful occupation for wages, salary or other compensation; it is applied for as a conversion at the Bureau's main office or an authorised office (so in the country), with the employer's certification of its foreign and Filipino employees (so tied to the employer); a principal pays PHP 10,130 for 1 year with a company outside the top 1,000 corporations (17,170 for 2 years, 24,210 for 3; 10,630 for 1 year with a top-1,000 corporation), plus US$50 a year for the ACR I-Card, which the form doesn't hold. The 1-year grant is kept as its term. The Quota Visa (13) is a permanent immigrant visa for nationals of countries that grant Filipinos the same privileges, at most 50 of one nationality a calendar year, converted at the main office for PHP 18,830 for a principal; the work it allows is read as any, as an immigrant's. Decision times, renewal of the 9G and naturalisation's count aren't on these pages.

sources.said: Foreign nationals who are proceeding to Philippines to engage in any lawful occupation, whether for wages or salary or other forms of compensation ... Notarized Certification of Number of Foreign and Filipino Employees ... Non-Top 1,000 Corporations VALIDITY PRINCIPAL DEP-SPOUSE DEP-B16 DEP-B14 1 Year Php 10,130.00

sources.title: Bureau of Immigration, Quota Visa (13)
sources.said: Nationals of countries which have diplomatic relations with the Philippines and grant the Filipinos the same immigration privileges under the principle of reciprocity which shall not be in excess of fifty (50) of any one nationality or without nationality for any one calendar year ... PRINCIPAL: Php 18,830.00 ... Fees are updated as of 06 March 2014 and may change without prior notice.
